method: build map recommendation: the W3-measured ws-ab binaries as they are, not a fresh build_native.ps1 build. ws-ab/c sources are byte-identical to git HEAD cfb7ea0 for every engine source (checked deepseek_v4.c, deepseek_v4_internal.h, backend_cuda_dsv4.cu/.h, backend_loader_dsv4.c, dsv4.def, Makefile.deepseek-v4, wex_decode.c, expert_store_wex.c, v4_route_tap.c; diff -rq finds only build outputs). exe: make -f Makefile.deepseek-v4 Windows defaults (-O3 -march=x86-64-v3 -flto -DCOLI_V4_GPU_TIER) with C:/msys64/ucrt64 gcc (imports UCRT api-ms-win-crt-*, like qwen38/qwen36/deepseek_v41.exe; 11-07 used mingw64/msvcrt). DLLs: build_native.ps1 nvcc recipes (ws-ab/dll-out/build-dll.cmd, build-dg-dll.cmd; dg = sm_120a + DeepGEMM), 110 exports each incl. dsv4_cuda_upload_fp8_ex/set_act_group/upload_head_exact/head_scores_exact; imports only cublasLt64_13.dll + KERNEL32 (cudart static). nvcc DLL hashes are not reproducible by rebuild.
